why: A path is attacker text too: an agent opens docs/notes.md and gets a different file whose name holds U+200B, and every tool that prints the name prints the invisible along with it. The fail side tracks docs/no<U+200B>tes.md, written only to the index; the pass side tracks docs/notacoes.md spelled with c-cedilla and o-tilde, which proves the name scan is about ignorable code points and not about non-ASCII. Stop scanning names and the fail side goes green; flag any non-ASCII name and the pass side goes red.
